verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own feature list names an auto attendant (the standard 'press 1 for sales' phone menu) as part of the RingEX suite, alongside call queues with 'better routing' and an AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls. These suggest callers can be routed to team queues, but the evidence is only feature-list mentions with no documentation of building the menu itself. missing for 10: documentation of configuring keypress menu options, explicit evidence of routing menu selections to team/department queues, details on admin setup workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
